newsitem.title: USA: IMX says stores to distribute Exorex.
newsitem.headline: IMX says stores to distribute Exorex.

text.p: IMX Corp said Wednesday it signed agreements for Rite Aid Corp, Walgreen Co and General Nutrition Cos Inc Centers to sell Exorex, IMX's psoriasis treatment medication, in all of their metropolitan New York stores.

IMX said in a release that more than 250 stores will distribute the medication used to treat psoriasis, a chronic skin disease, while regional wholesale distributor programs will also reach over 3,000 independent retailers.

Exorex is undergoing clinical tests at the Psoriasis Research and Treatment Center at Boston Medical Center; preliminary results from the study show "significant improvement in over 80 percent of patients after three months of treatment," IMX said.
The retail launch is scheduled to begin March 24, 1997.
